verdict.rationale: Temporal's durable execution model explicitly supports long-running workflows that survive crashes/restarts and resume exactly where they left off (temporal-docs-1, temporal-docs-9, temporal-docs-25), with Workers/Activities decoupled from the workflow's suspended state and test tooling that 'skips time' for long waits (temporal-docs-15/32), consistent with the platform's signature durable-timer design. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the underlying timer/persistence mechanism confirming zero compute is billed while a workflow sleeps, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of multi-month sleep durations in production.
